title: Cloudhop Meadows
tagline: Hop, dash and bloom your way to the flower portal at the top of the sky!
pitch: Cloudhop Meadows: a bright, juicy 3D platformer across floating sky islands. Run, double-jump and dash between candy-coloured islands and wobbly mushroom platforms, collect glowing star seeds, dodge spinning thorn bars, and reach the giant blooming flower portal at the top. Cheerful music, a bouncy HUD with a seed counter and timer.
controls: Space: jump (again in the air: double jump)

plan.title: Cloudhop Meadows
plan.tagline: Hop, dash and bloom your way to the flower portal at the top of the sky!
plan.core_loop: Run, double-jump and dash between candy-coloured floating islands, grab glowing star seeds, dodge spinning thorn bars, and climb island by island to the giant blooming flower portal at the top.
controls: Space: jump (tap again mid-air: double jump)
plan.win_condition: Collect at least 12 Star Seeds and reach the giant blooming flower portal on the top island before the 3-minute timer runs out.
plan.lose_condition: Fall into the cloud void or get clipped by a spinning thorn bar to lose a life (respawn at the last island checkpoint); 0 lives or time running out ends the run.
plan.art_direction: Candy-sculpted sky world: strawberry-pink, mint, butter-yellow and sky-blue islands with soft toon shading, thin ink outlines and glossy highlights, floating above a sea of fluffy cumulus. Warm afternoon sun, gentle bloom on the glowing star seeds, everything rounded like gumdrops. Mood: a cheerful candy kingdom in the clouds — Candy Land meets a puffy cloud garden.
concept_shots: The bunny hero mid-dash between two candy-coloured islands, mint scarf streaming behind, a sparkling arc of star seeds overhead and a sea of clouds far below.
A wobbly mushroom platform carrying the hero across a wide gap while a spinning thorn bar whirls just below the jump line, sparkle trail behind the dash.
The goal island: the giant blooming flower portal with layered pink petals opening around a glowing gold centre, confetti bursting as the bouncy arcade HUD shows the seed counter maxed out.

assets.sky: High-noon candy sky panorama: gradient from sky blue at the top to soft peach at the horizon, big fluffy white cumulus clouds, a warm sun disc, and a few tiny distant floating islands.

assets.music: Cheerful chiptune-pop: ukulele, xylophone, hand claps and bouncy bass, major key, ~120 BPM, light and bouncy

sfx.prompt: Bright ascending two-note chime with a tiny sparkle shimmer, like picking up a glowing seed
Short bouncy boing whoosh, cartoon springy
Soft squishy thump with a little puff, like landing on a candy platform
Comical bonk with a wobble, not scary, cartoon hit
Snappy dash whoosh with a rising zip
Bright fanfare arpeggio with confetti pop and a warm chime finale

props.name: mushroom
props.prompt: Plump candy mushroom with a glossy pink cap, white spots and a mint stem, rounded and chunky

props.name: flower_portal
props.prompt: Giant blooming flower with layered glossy pink petals, a glowing golden centre and a soft halo, candy sculpture style

features: Double jump + air dash: platformer tuning (Player.TUNING.platformer) with a dash burst, speedLines and a sparkle trail on dash
Wobbly mushroom platforms: mover platforms (Level MOTIONS pingpong) dressed with the candy mushroom prop between island hops
Spinning thorn bars: spinner hazards (Gameplay.HAZARDS spinner) placed in the gaps between islands to dodge mid-jump
Star seed pickup juice: sparkle burst, floating +1 text and a chime on every collect (FX.auto + FX.sparkle)
Giant blooming flower portal: goal portal on the goal island dressed with the flower_portal prop, confetti + starBurst on win
Bouncy arcade HUD: seed counter, 3-minute timer and heart lives with generated candy icons (UI.hud, arcade style)
plan.mapping_notes: The pitch maps almost 1:1 onto the kit. Floating sky islands -> level_kind sky_islands (islands joined by hops, goal island with arch, bonus island via moving platform). Candy-coloured -> look 'candy'. Glowing star seeds -> collectible tag 'seed' in mode 'collect' (target 12 of 30 opens the goal). Spinning thorn bars -> 'spinner' hazards, since the pitch has no enemies to stomp, enemies=0 and the spinners carry all the danger. Wobbly mushroom platforms: the kit has no literal wobble, so pingpong mover platforms dressed with a generated candy-mushroom prop stand in for the bouncy mushroom hops. Giant blooming flower portal -> the sky_islands goal portal on the goal island, dressed with a flower_portal prop plus confetti/starBurst FX. The hero is unspecified, so a bunny with a streaming scarf is the closest species to 'Cloudhop' (hopping). Bouncy HUD with seed counter and timer -> arcade UI style with generated seed/clock/heart icons and a 180s timer. Double-jump and dash come from the platformer tuning with speedLines juice.

result.summary: Cloudhop Meadows: a candy-styled 3D sky-island platformer built on the scaffold. The bunny hero (pink body, mint scarf) runs, double-jumps and dashes across candy-coloured floating islands, collects 12 of 30 glowing Star Seeds to unlock the flower portal at the top, all under a 3-minute timer with 3 lives. Spinning thorn bars (spinner hazards) guard the hops between islands, candy-mushroom props and splat landmarks dress the route, and the arcade HUD shows the seed counter (with target 12), countdown timer, heart lives, objective line and minimap. FX juice: dash speed-lines + spark bursts, star-burst + floating "+2" on every seed pickup, and confetti + star burst at the goal on win. Generated sky, music and SFX all play via Assets/Audio.auto. Verified with two play_game runs: zero console errors, autopilot moves along the route and collects seeds (one legitimate spinner death confirmed hazards work).
changes: Added spinner (thorn bar) hazards in the gaps between islands, oriented along the route with length scaled to the gap
Tuned the platformer player: mint scarf colour, kept bunny species + double jump/dash feel
Upgraded HUD: seed counter with target 12, objective line, arcade style, minimap, timer, lives
Shortened the title subtitle and control credit to fit the UI
Added dash juice (speed lines + spark burst), seed-pickup juice (star burst + floating +2 text), and win celebration (candy-coloured confetti + star burst at the portal) via game.on event handlers
Kept scaffold's generated sky, scenery props/splats, title screen, FX.auto, Audio.auto, Debug.install and game.start()
known_issues: Autopilot collected 10/12 seeds in the short test windows and hasn't reached the win yet, but it is progressing correctly along the route; a full run should complete the 12-seed target and reach the portal
A harmless THREE.WebGLProgram info-log warning appears (signed/unsigned mismatch) — not an error, from three.js shader compilation

post_stages.stage: re-recorded and re-scored after the final kit update
